lessons: Synthetic long-action transport qualification can establish byte-exact envelope capacity without covering the reasoning-length tail of a realistic multi-step software-engineering trajectory.

For AtomCode-mediated models, wrapper timeout and model output budget must be qualified separately. Q0.1 repaired the former; the first real source episode exposed the latter at exactly 16384 completion tokens.

A scientific source episode that has already consumed model-content-bearing steps is not retryable merely because a later provider invocation terminates nonzero. Exactly-once authority applies to the logical episode, not only to its final packet.
When source support requires all fixed units, an early consumed-invalid unit retires the entire substrate rather than authorizing replacement or continuation on the remaining units.
reopen_condition: A new disjoint source/future pool plus a prospective higher source-output-budget qualification on new non-scientific realistic MiniSWEAgent coding envelopes. Keep AtomGit Qwen3.8, 900s wrapper ceiling, exact-base runtime and PACTA-MSR method fixed; do not reuse the retired ten-pair source pool.
